payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustively check all possible single face rotations (3 faces × 2 directions) and test if any yields a solved cube.
payload.rationale: The solution hardcodes the 3 rotation permutations and their inverses, then applies each and checks if solved. This is a complete search over the finite move set, not using branch-and-bound or backtracking. Thus permutation enumeration is the closest.
